column1: 30901§scholarship§ˈskɒləʃɪp§n. 学术研究；学问；学术成就；奖学金§In combining elements of a mixtape album with scholarly essays that connect Carson's lyrics to historical and contemporary contexts for listeners both inside and outside academia, Carson's album helped redefine how scholarship is created and shared.§通过把混音带专辑的元素与学术随笔结合起来——这些随笔为学术界内外的听众把卡森的歌词与历史及当代语境联系起来——卡森的专辑帮助重新定义了**学术**成果的创作与分享方式。§Timbuktu was a center of trade and scholarship in the Sahara desert.§廷巴克图曾是撒哈拉沙漠中的贸易与**学术**中心。§§scholarly essays 学术随笔；a scholarship to study abroad 出国留学奖学金§§改译文：原译漏了主句（专辑帮助重新定义学术的创作与分享），并把 inside and outside academia 错译成「听众身内身外」

30902§strain§streɪn§n. （生物）品系；菌株；（思想等的）流派、脉络；压力；紧张 v. 拉紧；扭伤§Scientists aren’t entirely sure why C. geaster is distributed in this way (genetic analysis reveals that the US and Japanese strains diverged 19 million years ago), but the mushroom appears to be very selective: it is typically found on the decaying stumps and roots of only a few tree species that are abundant in these areas.§科学家并不完全清楚 C. geaster 为何如此分布（基因分析显示，美国与日本的**品系**在 1900 万年前分化），但这种蘑菇似乎非常挑剔：它通常只长在这些地区数量丰富的少数几种树木腐烂的树桩和根上。§Distinct strains of microhistory emerged at different times in Italy, Iceland, and elsewhere, for example, and while microhistories of the 1980s reflected the era’s interest in labor history, the “global turn” in recent historiography sparked a wave of globally contextualized microhistories.§例如，各不相同的微观史学**脉络**在不同时期出现于意大利、冰岛等地：1980 年代的微观史反映了那个时代对劳工史的兴趣，而近年史学的「全球转向」则掀起了一波全球语境化的微观史。§§under strain 处于压力之下§§改译文：原译以「但……」收尾，补全后半

30903§protocol§ˈprəʊtəkɒl§n. （科研、操作的）规程；草案；礼仪；外交礼节；（计算机）协议§The spatial distribution of isotopes within individual bodies of water is not always homogenous, potentially compromising studies with inadequate sampling protocols.§各水体内部同位素的空间分布并不总是均匀的，这可能使采样**规程**不完善的研究结论受到削弱。§§§§sampling protocols 采样规程§§

30904§indigenous§ɪnˈdɪdʒənəs§adj. 本土的；土生土长的；原住民的§The compositional strategy of Untitled, a 1955 work by Cherokee artist Edna Massey, is far more closely aligned with Abstract Expressionism—a mid-twentieth-century school of painting dominated by European American artists—than with traditionally abstract forms of Indigenous art, such as beadwork.§切罗基族艺术家 Edna Massey 1955 年的作品《无题》，其构图策略与抽象表现主义（一个由欧裔美国艺术家主导的二十世纪中期绘画流派）的契合，远比与珠饰等**原住民**艺术的传统抽象形式更为紧密。§Both centers contrast with museums that aren't Indigenous-led; when displaying Indigenous artifacts, such museums tend to anticipate mainly non-Indigenous audiences and rely on Euro-centric strategies for designing exhibits.§这两座中心与非原住民主导的博物馆形成对照：后者展出**原住民**器物时，预设的主要是非原住民观众，并依赖欧洲中心的展览设计策略。§§Indigenous art 原住民艺术§与 native 近义，但 indigenous 更常用于族群与物种的原生性表述§改译文：原译漏译破折号里对抽象表现主义的说明和「如珠饰」；改例句2：两处「--」应为连字符「-」

30905§icon§ˈaɪkɒn§n. 偶像；标志性人物；圣像；（电脑）图标§In some works, Villasana focuses on celebrating cultural icons who are people of color, as she does in her depiction of musician and composer Nina Simone.§在一些作品中，Villasana 着力颂扬身为有色人种的文化**偶像**，她对音乐家兼作曲家妮娜·西蒙的描绘便是如此。§The style's inclusivity has been encouraged—excessively so, many fans say—by the music-streaming service Spotify, whose popular playlist of hyperpop songs balances core figures with distinct outliers, like 1980s icon Kate Bush.§这种风格的包容性受到了——许多乐迷认为过了头——音乐流媒体平台 Spotify 的助推：其热门超流行歌单既容纳核心人物，也容纳像 1980 年代**偶像**凯特·布什这样的特立独行者。§§country icons 乡村音乐偶像；click the icon 点击图标§§改译文：原译是另一句（调幅电台与乡村音乐偶像）的翻译，按英文重译；补译文2（用 inclusive 条同一句的译文）

30906§inclusive§ɪnˈkluːsɪv§adj. 包容的；包含广泛的；包括在内的§The style's inclusivity has been encouraged—excessively so, many fans say—by the music-streaming service Spotify, whose popular playlist of hyperpop songs balances core figures with distinct outliers, like 1980s icon Kate Bush.§这种风格的**包容性**受到了——许多乐迷认为过了头——音乐流媒体平台 Spotify 的助推：其热门超流行歌单既容纳核心人物，也容纳像 1980 年代偶像凯特·布什这样的特立独行者。§It suggests that, because they are relatively up to date, more recently published collections of cyberpunk stories are likely to be more inclusive than earlier anthologies.§它提示：由于相对时新，较晚出版的赛博朋克小说集很可能比早期选集更具**包容性**。§include（包含）→ inclusion（纳入、包含）→ inclusive / inclusivity（包容的 / 包容性）§inclusivity n. 包容性；inclusion n. 纳入；包含（真题另见 18 次：the inclusion of… / for inclusion in…）§§删评论；原书错：义项把名词 inclusivity 和词族说明都标成「形容词」

30907§premiere§ˈpremieə(r)§v. 首演；首映 n. 首演；首映§A revised version of the musical premiered on Broadway in 2019, in a larger production.§该音乐剧的修订版于 2019 年在百老汇**首演**，制作规模更大。§Choreographers George Balanchine and Martha Graham both contributed sections to the dance piece Episodes, which premiered at New York’s City Center of Music and Drama in 1959.§编舞家乔治·巴兰钦与玛莎·格雷厄姆共同为舞作《插曲》贡献了段落，该作 1959 年**首演**于纽约市音乐戏剧中心。§§premiere on Broadway 在百老汇首演§与 premier（首相；首要的）拼写相近，注意区分§

30908§marvel§ˈmɑːvl§n. 奇迹；令人惊叹的人或事物 v. 惊叹；感到惊奇§Take, for instance, Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), which is part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe franchise.§以 2019 年的《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》为例，它属于**漫威**电影宇宙系列。§It's true that this movie resembles earlier Marvel movies.§的确，这部电影与早先的**漫威**电影相似。§§marvel at 对…感到惊叹§两句真题里的 Marvel 都是漫威（公司名），不是「奇迹」义§原书错：义项拿 the Marvel Cinematic Universe（漫威电影宇宙）当「值得惊叹的事物」的例子，那里的 Marvel 是公司名

30909§scandal§ˈskændl§n. 丑闻；公愤；耻辱§President Richard Nixon is most famous for his participation in the 1970s Watergate political scandal …§理查德·尼克松总统最著名的，是他卷入 1970 年代的水门政治**丑闻**……§§§§political scandal 政治丑闻；a scandal to the family 家族的耻辱§§改译文：删去英文里没有的后半（那是 ethics 条接下去的一句）

30910§genre§ˈʒɒnrə§n. （文艺作品的）类型；体裁；流派§Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives (2010) and other films by Thai director Apichatpong Weerasethakul are contributions to slow cinema, an art house genre whose contemplative pacing and deprivileging of narrative are further exemplified by films such as Andrei Tarkovsky's Solaris (1972).§《能召回前世的布米叔叔》（2010）等泰国导演阿彼察邦·韦拉斯哈古的影片，是对「慢电影」的贡献——慢电影是一种艺术电影**类型**，其沉思般的节奏与对叙事的弱化，在安德烈·塔可夫斯基的《飞向太空》（1972）等影片中有进一步体现。§In a recent study, Antonia Olivia Dolan and colleagues allowed participants to listen to (and adjust the volume of) recordings of music in popular genres like heavy metal and acoustic folk, as well as recordings of nature sounds.§在最近的一项研究中，Antonia Olivia Dolan 及同事让参与者聆听（并调节音量）流行**类型**音乐的录音（如重金属与原声民谣），以及自然声音的录音。§§art house genre 艺术电影类型§与 category 相比，genre 专用于文艺作品分类§改译文：原译把「沉思般的节奏、弱化叙事」概括成「注重氛围」，漏了塔可夫斯基《飞向太空》等例子

30911§colonial§kəˈləʊniəl§adj. 殖民的；殖民地的；殖民时期（风格）的§Scholars cite Pedro Páramo, the 1955 novel by Mexican author Juan Rulfo, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the folkloric traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel.§学者们把墨西哥作家胡安·鲁尔福 1955 年的小说《佩德罗·巴拉莫》视为魔幻现实主义的奠基之作。魔幻现实主义是一种拉美小说风格：反现实的情节手法（常借自美洲原住民社会与**殖民地**社会的民间传统）被运用在现代小说典型的、其余皆为写实的再现方式之中。§It included a model of Gehry House, a 1978‒88 project by US architect Frank Gehry featuring jagged geometric forms extending from a Dutch colonial exterior.§展品中包括「盖里自宅」的模型——美国建筑师弗兰克·盖里 1978-88 年的项目，以从荷兰**殖民风格**外立面上斜逸而出的几何体块著称。§colony 殖民地；colonize 殖民；colonialism 殖民主义§colonial rule 殖民统治§§改译文：原译把后半概括成「让超自然事件显得平常」，漏了情节手法借自原住民与殖民地社会民间传统等内容；改例句2：句末多一个句点

30912§compound§ˈkɒmpaʊnd§n. 化合物；混合物 adj. 复合的 v. 使加剧；使恶化§Some plants' leaves emit a chemical compound (2-methyl-1,3-butadiene) that is thought to be a defense against insects.§有些植物的叶片会释放一种化学**化合物**（2-甲基-1,3-丁二烯），被认为是对付昆虫的一种防御机制。§Researchers modified leaves of the same plant species so that some emitted the compound and others didn’t, then placed hornworms—leaf-eating insects—between leaves of both types and allowed the hornworms to feed for 90 minutes.§研究者改造同一植物物种的叶片，使一些散发该**化合物**、另一些不散发，然后把天蛾——食叶昆虫——放在两类叶片之间，任其取食 90 分钟。§§organic compounds 有机化合物；a compound sentence 复合句§名词、形容词读 /ˈkɒmpaʊnd/，动词读 /kəmˈpaʊnd/§改例句：删去句首混入的图表 OCR 乱码（标题、刻度数字、图例），plants' 后补空格，「2- methyl」删去多余空格；改译文：相应删去图表说明

30913§ossify§ˈɒsɪfaɪ§v. 僵化；（思想、制度）固化；（医）骨化§While both approaches engage with influential figures, those who do philosophy treat such figures as vital interlocutors who facilitate new insights rather than as ossified authorities who, though relevant to the present, primarily represent the discipline's past.§两种进路都要与权威人物打交道，但「做哲学」的人把这些人物当作能激发新洞见的活跃对话者，而非徒然代表学科过往的**僵化**（ossified）权威——他们虽与当下相关，主要却只承载学科的历史。§§§§ossified adj. 僵化的（过去分词作定语：ossified authorities 僵化的权威）；ossification n. 僵化；骨化（the ossification of bureaucracy 官僚体制的僵化）§os-（骨）+ -ify（化），本义软组织骨化；近义 fossilize（化石→僵化）；反义 stay fluid / keep evolving；真题与 interlocutor 同句：vital interlocutors（活跃的对话者）vs ossified authorities（僵化的权威）§

30914§perception§pəˈsepʃn§n. 感知；知觉；看法；观念；洞察力§Georgia Tech roboticists De’Aira Bryant and Ayanna Howard, along with ethicist Jason Borenstein, were interested in people’s perceptions of robots’ competence.§佐治亚理工学院的机器人学者 De'Aira Bryant 与 Ayanna Howard，以及伦理学者 Jason Borenstein，想了解人们对机器人「胜任力」的**看法**。§Neuroscientist Artin Arshamian and his team sought to determine what affects a person’s perception of an odor as pleasant: is it culture, personal taste, or aspects of human anatomy?§神经科学家 Artin Arshamian 及团队试图确定：影响一个人**觉得**气味宜人的因素究竟是文化、个人口味，还是人体构造？§§perception of risk 风险感知；public perception 公众观感§§改例句：删去句首混入的表格注释「Rows in table may not add up to 100 due to rounding.」

30915§metropolitan§ˌmetrəˈpɒlɪtən§adj. 大都市的；大城市的；都会区的§Often, governments will report a value for the city proper (including only residents within the city limits) and another for the larger metropolitan area (including residents from nearby places beyond the city limits).§政府往往会同时报告「市区本体」（仅含市界内居民）与「更大**都会区**」（含市界外居民）两个数值。§Through the Urban Wildlife Information Network, citizen scientists systematically document animals they observe in metropolitan areas.§通过「城市野生动物信息网络」，公民科学家系统地记录他们在**都会区**观察到的动物。§§metropolitan area 都会区§metropolitan area 都会区（含市界外的周边地区）≠ city proper 市区本体§

30916§consecutive§kənˈsekjətɪv§adj. 连续的；接连不断的§The time between consecutive pulses of an RRAT is referred to as a period.§旋转射电暂现源（RRAT）**相邻**两次脉冲之间的时间被称为一个周期。§§§§consecutive pulses 连续的脉冲§与 successive 近义，但 consecutive 更强调「无间隔」§

30917§verse§vɜːs§n. 韵文；诗；诗句；（歌曲的）主歌；（《圣经》的）节§Though poems that became fugitive verse were typical of newspaper poetry of their era in their reliance on such elements as simple rhyme schemes and everyday settings, the phenomenon of fugitive verse represents a significant departure from the dominant model of literary authorship in which a work is controlled by a single and publicly identified author.§尽管成为流散诗歌的那些诗在依赖简单韵式、日常场景等元素上是其时代报纸诗歌的典型，但流散**诗歌**这一现象明显背离了占主导地位的文学作者模式——在那种模式中，一部作品由单一的、公开署名的作者掌控。§Whitmore, published in the Chicago Evening Post in 1878, exemplifies the phenomenon of “fugitive verse,” poems reprinted in newspapers and other nineteenth-century US periodicals without authorial oversight or even, in many cases, knowledge.§Whitmore 1878 年发表于《芝加哥晚报》的这首诗，是「流散**诗歌**（fugitive verse）」现象的例证——未经作者监督、甚至在许多情况下不为作者所知，就在报刊及其他十九世纪美国期刊上转载的诗歌。§§fugitive verse 流散诗（真题指未经作者监督、被报刊辗转转载的诗）§§改译文：原译只译了前半并以「但……」收尾，按英文重译；改译文2：fugitive verse 与第一句统一为「流散诗歌」，删去引号内多余空格

30918§patent§ˈpætnt§n. 专利；专利权 v. 取得…的专利 adj. 明显的§The book covers important parts of its subject's life, including Edison's patent for a vote recorder, his creation of a carbon-filament electric light bulb, and his development of a rechargeable battery.§这本书涵盖了传主一生的重要部分，包括爱迪生的投票记录器**专利**、碳丝电灯泡的发明，以及他研制的可充电电池。§In 1903, Mary Anderson patented a device that cleared rain and snow from a car’s windshield, improving visibility for drivers.§1903 年，玛丽·安德森为一项清除汽车挡风玻璃上雨雪的装置**取得专利**，改善了驾驶员的视野。§§patent for sth …的专利；a patent error 明显的错误§作「明显的」讲读 /ˈpeɪtnt/§改译文：原译以「……」收尾，补全末项 rechargeable battery

30919§mar§mɑː(r)§v. 损坏；损害；破坏（美好、完整）§… but perhaps in doing so the thorough clerical aspect of the whole might have been somewhat marred.§……但若那样做，整体那十足的教士气派恐怕就会**受损**几分。§§§§marred by 因…而受损§常用于被动 marred，语气比 damage 更强调「破坏其美好」§改例句：原书例句是 The Sands of Mars（只有 Mars，不含本词），换成 U12 clerical 条的同一真题句（含 marred）；改译文：随例句改，原译「正因如此」误解了 in doing so

30920§ethics§ˈeθɪks§n. 道德准则；伦理；职业道德；伦理学§… a convoluted tale of criminality and eroded ethics involving a constellation of associates such as security operative Jack Caulfield and Attorney General John Mitchell.§……一桩罪行与**道德**沦丧交织的复杂故事，牵涉一众相关人物，如安全特工杰克·考尔菲尔德和司法部长约翰·米切尔。§§§§eroded ethics 沦丧的道德§作「伦理学」讲不可数、谓语用单数；作「道德规范」讲常用复数§改译文：原译加了英文里没有的「水门事件是」「阴谋」，漏了后半牵涉的人物

30921§commentary§ˈkɒməntri§n. 评论；评注；（体育等的）实况解说§The work is manifestly a commentary on constraint, but many critics focus on Valdez and the social constraints women faced at the time, which is understandable but leaves the presence of Valdez's male collaborator Sandoval unexplained.§这件作品显然是对「约束」的一则**评论**，但许多批评者把焦点放在 Valdez 以及当时女性所面临的种种社会约束上——这可以理解，却解释不了 Valdez 的男性合作者 Sandoval 为何出现在作品中。§Rather than being an arbitrary stylistic choice, hyperpop's persistent modification of the voice functions as a commentary on how digital technology mediates human experience today.§超流行乐对声音的持续改造并非随意的风格选择，而是对数字技术如何中介当代人类经验的一种**评注**。§§a commentary on sth 对…的评论§§改译文：漏译后半（这可以理解，却解释不了男性合作者 Sandoval 的存在）；改例句2：to day 应为 today

30922§scenario§səˈnɑːriəʊ§n. （设想的）情境；情况；方案；剧情梗概§All the participants then described how they would respond to a workplace scenario.§随后，所有参与者都描述了他们会如何应对某个职场**情境**。§A student reviews the findings and suggests that in the given scenario, those countries could meet the demand with solar energy alone but not with wind alone.§一位学生审视这些发现后提出：在给定**情境**下，这些国家仅靠太阳能即可满足需求，仅靠风能则不能。§§a workplace scenario 一个职场情境§与 situation 相比，scenario 更强调「假设性的整条情节线」§

30923§coin§kɔɪn§n. 硬币 v. 创造（新词）；铸造（硬币）§Issuing a one-dollar coin yields positive seigniorage—the profit generated when the face value of a coin exceeds the unit cost of producing it—for Singapore’s government, which in turn can be used to fund such services as transportation.§发行一美元**硬币**可为新加坡政府带来正值的铸币税——即硬币面值超过其单位生产成本时所产生的收益——这些收益又可用于资助交通等服务。§§§§coin a term 造一个说法§§改译文：漏译「为新加坡政府」和后半（收益可用于资助交通等服务）

30924§census§ˈsensəs§n. 人口普查；（官方的）统计调查§Northeastern North Carolina’s Camden County is among the most rural counties in the United States: the US Census Bureau classified it as 99.5% rural in 2010.§北卡罗来纳州东北部的卡姆登县是美国最乡村化的县之一：美国**人口普查**局在 2010 年将其认定为 99.5% 乡村。§§§§the US Census Bureau 美国人口普查局§§
